reviews.note: Adds the plague to the 2026-27 window, which ties this to plague-calendar-fall-to-spring.
Survival conditioned on having the word as a foundation. Another clause that explains any outcome after the fact.
The mushroom cloud question is asked but the answer is cut off in this passage. Dates a 2023 vision worth locating in full.
Given 1 June 2025, three weeks before the Fordow strike, and attributed to a January word. If that January statement is in the corpus this is the sharpest military hit in the record.

Same $200 figure as the 2023 tellings, now with a stated mechanism: strikes on refineries drive it and the flow stimulates the American economy. Oil fell rather than rose after June 2025, so the mechanism half is testable and did not hold.
Bundles a checkable political read, Trump preferring diplomacy while Israel acts anyway, with an undated black swan.
A dated expectation for his daughter's healing by 3 July 2025. Left unassigned: it is a family matter and the corpus should not score it, but the date is recorded on the mention.
The military parade is 14 June 2025, which was already announced, so this half is not a forward call.
Names a city, which poland-war-spread does not. Kept separate for that reason.
The umpire defence: he calls it as he saw it and the crowd has a worse angle. Worth keeping alongside grace-for-missed-words.
Adds the economy and the black, which links it to the black horse and dark-year material.
Same sentence as eEd1C8oRkiE@944 five days earlier, including the green screen aside.

The second instance of this structure after superbowl-winner-private, and here the prohibition is explicit: betting on it would end the gift. The only class of prediction that could be independently scored is placed out of reach.
He says he wrote the forecasts down, which would make them checkable if the notes exist and are dated.
